faqs.question: What SEO services does IGENTX provide in the UAE?
faqs.answer: We provide technical SEO audits, on-page optimisation, bilingual content strategy, Google Maps local SEO and monthly performance reporting for businesses targeting Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the wider UAE.

faqs.question: Do you provide local SEO for Dubai and the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes. We optimise Google Business Profile, local citations, location pages and bilingual schema markup. Local search in the UAE benefits from mobile-first performance, relevant Arabic and English content, and strong technical foundations.

faqs.question: Can you help us rank in both Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. We plan hreflang tags, URL structures and keyword strategies for bilingual sites so you can rank in both languages without duplicate content issues.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to show results in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Technical improvements can show gains within weeks. Competitive keyword rankings typically take 3-6 months with consistent content and authority building. Local SEO for city-specific queries may show faster results.

faqs.question: Do you have UAE SEO case studies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Moduluxe Group achieved 300% organic traffic growth after a bilingual, performance-first Next.js rebuild and SEO foundation by IGENTX. Read the full case study at /case-studies/moduluxe-group.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing SEO support?
faqs.answer: Yes. SEO is ongoing work. We offer monthly retainers covering content updates, technical monitoring and performance reviews tailored to UAE competition levels.

faqs.question: Do you also provide global SEO services?
faqs.answer: Yes. IGENTX delivers SEO worldwide as well as in the UAE. See our global SEO services page for international and multi-market engagements.

faqs.question: How do I get started with IGENTX SEO in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Book a free consultation via our contact form or WhatsApp. We will review your site, discuss your UAE markets and share a scoped proposal within 24 hours.
